reason: Creators already walk into my salon every month offering a reel for a free service, so I get posts without spending cash. Paying a creator ₹5,000 plus a fee to Mitra on top makes no sense when barter already works for me.
objection: Barter works fine for me; why pay cash plus a fee? I have never paid a creator in cash and I'm not sure a reel brings in enough paying clients to cover it.
would_change_my_mind: If Mitra let me run my barter creators through the promo codes for free, and the count showed that one paid creator actually brought far more paying clients than the free-service ones did.
